facts.about: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is engaged in the business of manufacturing, developing and marketing a wide range of branded and generic formulations and Active Pharma Ingredients (APIs). The company and its subsidiaries has various manufacturing facilities spread across the world with trading and other incidental and related activities extending to global market.  It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 120% of PAT
Promoter stake down 1.8 pts in a year (now 52.68%)

business.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. is a global pharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, and markets a wide range of pharmaceutical products, including generics, specialty medicines, and active pharmaceutical ingredients, to improve patient care across international markets.

scorecard.promised: High single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: 11.2% year-to-date growth for the first half of FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Revenue grew 10.5% in Jun 2026 and 11.9% in Sep 2026, exceeding the high single-digit target.

scorecard.promised: R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of sales for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Management admits spend needs to significantly ramp up in subsequent quarters.
scorecard.evidence: Management acknowledges current spend is below guidance, requiring a 'significant ramp up' to meet the 6-7% full-year target.

scorecard.promised: Expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 of FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Transaction remains on track for the Q4 FY27 timeline.
scorecard.evidence: Management reiterated the Q4 FY27 closing timeline in the Sep 2026 call.

scorecard.promised: Expected to be in the range of 25% for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Tax rate in Q1 FY27 was used as the benchmark for the year.
scorecard.evidence: Sep 2026 PAT of ₹1,995 cr on revenue of ₹16,199 cr suggests margin pressure or tax volatility.

narrative.scoreline: Management has consistently exceeded conservative revenue guidance while struggling to deploy R&D capital at the promised rate.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: India growth is robust, driven by volume expansion and new product launches.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Consolidated revenue grew 11.9% in Sep 2026, supporting the claim of robust domestic performance.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Innovative Medicines crossed $1 billion in the US for the first time in FY26.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Annual revenue reached ₹58,462 cr in Mar 2026, consistent with a scaling specialty portfolio.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: U.S. generic decline is due to Lenalidomide erosion and competition.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Mar 2026 margins dropped to 27% from 32% in Dec 2025, reflecting generic pricing pressure.

bull: Revenue growth is accelerating, hitting 11.9% in Sep 2026 versus a high single-digit guidance.
Strong cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow at 120% of PAT.
Specialty portfolio (Innovative Medicines) has achieved critical mass, exceeding $1 billion in US sales.
bear: R&D execution is lagging, requiring a 'significant ramp up' to meet the 6-7% of sales guidance.
Net profit fell sequentially to ₹1,995 cr in Sep 2026 from ₹2,901 cr in Jun 2026.
Multiple manufacturing facilities remain under US FDA 'Official Action Indicated' status, hindering new generic launches.
watch: R&D spend in Q3 FY27 to verify the promised 'significant ramp up'.

claims.claim: Slowdown was driven by a mix of factors including market dynamics and execution; interventions are in place.
claims.quote: No, it's really a variety of things. I think there's a bit of market, but frankly, part of it is execution as well, and that's the intervention we put in place.

claims.claim: Growth is robust, driven by volume expansion, new product launches, and pricing across all major therapy areas.
claims.quote: So what I'm trying to say, our growth is quite robust in terms of volume and we are growing by volume and new products. So almost like 50% to 60% of our growth comes from volume plus new product.

claims.claim: R&D investment is a function of clinical trial recruitment; infrastructure is being put in place to accelerate.
claims.quote: So I think the R&D investment is a function of the start and our ability to recruit subjects in the clinical trial. So we expect that to pick up because we are putting in place appropriate infrastructure in place for that.

claims.claim: Growth is driven by field force expansion in tier 2 and tier 3 cities and new product launches.
claims.quote: We also -- you also know we did a field force expansion in the past, and that is also helping us to grow the business in tier 2, tier 3 tiers.

claims.claim: The decline is primarily due to Lenalidomide erosion and additional competition in certain products.
claims.quote: Our Innovative Medicines portfolio continued to grow, and this was offset by lower sales in the generic business, largely due to Lenalidomide erosion, but also due to additional competition in certain products.

claims.claim: Margin improvement is driven by a better product mix in branded generics and innovative medicines.
claims.quote: We've seen good growth in our branded generics business as well as our innovative medicines business. Both of these have resulted in a healthier margin profile for the quarter.

claims.claim: Margins were lower due to lower milestone income, seasonality, reduced lenalidomide contribution, and elevated US spending.
claims.quote: Ex-forex, EBITDA margins were lower quarter-on-quarter due to several factors, including lower milestone income, some seasonality, reduced contribution from lenalidomide in Q4 versus Q3 and higher spend in certain geographies, including US.

claims.claim: Sun Pharma achieved the highest market share gain in India since the Ranbaxy acquisition.
claims.quote: I am pleased to note that this year, we have seen the highest gain in market share for Sun since Ranbaxy acquisition.

claims.claim: Innovative Medicines crossed $1 billion in the US for the first time in fiscal 2026.
claims.quote: I'm also pleased to note for the year that Innovative Medicines crossed $1 billion for the first time in the United States.

claims.claim: The acquisition is complementary as it adds biosimilars and women's health to the existing portfolio.
claims.quote: So in my opinion, it's a complementary because we don't have even product overlaps, very negligible product overlap is there. And biosimilar is a new addition.

claims.claim: Sun Pharma plans to launch generic Semaglutide on day-one of patent expiry in India.
claims.quote: Sun Pharma plans to be in market on day-one of a generic launch.

claims.claim: Generic business will recover once manufacturing sites achieve compliance to launch new products.
claims.quote: I think overall for the US, we see the innovative medicines continuing to grow and the generic business will start to recover once we are in manufacturing compliance for a number of our sites in order to launch new products.

claims.claim: We are open to raising debt for acquisitions if necessary, while maintaining focus on organic growth.
claims.quote: At the same point of time, I think we have also indicated that for acquisition, if it is necessary, we are comfortable in raising debt.

claims.claim: The product is positioned for new patients rather than those who have failed existing therapies.
claims.quote: We would mostly anticipate new patients.

risks.text: Company involved in various legal proceedings including product liability, investigations, anti-trust, and regulatory matters.
Significant tax litigations and judgements regarding recognition of deferred tax assets impact reported results.
Related party transactions are essential to core business and subject to robust governance processes.
Several manufacturing facilities are currently classified as Official Action Indicated by the US FDA.
